title: Free Spirit Yacht Cruises
specs: Cruises on Lake Michigan and Chicago River with views of city skyline and landmarks
Custom catering and full-service bar available
Children under 90 lbs. must wear life jackets on outside deck areas; guests must provide life jackets for infants or small children
No smoking aboard; no sitting on handrails; no standing on benches or chairs; no swimming; no shots, beer bongs, or drinking games
Yachts accommodate up to 120 guests; minimum 50 person charter
Private groups only; no bachelor parties; bridal and baby showers allowed
includes: Use of yacht with indoor and outdoor spaces
Stereo system with AUX cord, XM radio, and microphone
blurb: Guests charter private yachts for events such as corporate meetings, family reunions, weddings, and parties. Cruises offer customizable experiences including catering, entertainment, and scenic views of Chicago landmarks. The yachts accommodate up to 120 guests and provide indoor and outdoor spaces with amenities like stereo systems and marine toilets.
extraNote: Non-refundable deposit of 50% required to secure date · Balance due 10 days prior to charter date in cleared funds · No refunds for inclement weather · Prices do not include tax, gratuities, or 3.5% credit card fee · Dock J slip 24 in Burnham Harbor, Chicago, about 5 minutes from downtown Chicago · April 15th – October 15th
